title: A Framework for Spatial Quantum Sensing
summary: Quantum sensor networks promise precision advantages over classical and single-sensor strategies, in particular when the estimator is non-local. We address the problem of finding such estimators through a framework we connote spatial quantum sensing: given an underlying field interrogated by a network of quantum sensors at fixed positions, construct an estimator for a property of the field, for example, distinguishing a source of signal, or evaluating the field or its derivatives at an arbitrary point.
